Hi, I'm Ron! I'm a graduate student in the **Master of Science in Digital Marketing (MSDM)** program at Cal Poly Pomona. I like working where data and storytelling meet: figuring out what the numbers say, then turning that into content people actually want to watch or read.

Outside of class, I run **LAfirethrifts**, a secondhand clothing store with an anti-fast-fashion mission aimed at high school and college students. I also create video and promo content with Associated Students, Inc. (ASI) at Cal Poly Pomona.

## Career Aspirations

I want to build a career in digital marketing analytics, helping brands and nonprofits make smarter decisions with their data. My goal is to be the person on a team who can set up the tracking, run the analysis, *and* explain the results in a way that leads to action. Long term, I'd love to bring that same data-driven approach to growing my own brand.
